description: This file implements the Singleton pattern for managing singleton instances within the Thunder::Core namespace. It defines methods for registering, unregistering, disposing, and accessing singleton instances, along with destructor logic to ensure cleanup.

classes.name: Singleton::SingletonList
classes.description: A container class managing a list of singleton instances, providing registration, unregistration, disposal, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: Singleton::ListInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton list instance, ensuring a single static list is used throughout the application.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::~SingletonList
methods.description: Destructor that checks for non-empty singleton list and calls Dispose to clean up.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Dispose
methods.description: Deletes all singleton instances managed by the list.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Register
methods.description: Adds a singleton instance to the list.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Unregister
methods.description: Removes a singleton instance from the list.
